breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero by symmetry, but for a simply supported beam under a midspan point load the slope is zero at midspan, not at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the simply supported beam with zero deflection at supports and free (non-zero) slope at supports. It explicitly states 'the slope at the supports is free' and correctly identifies that slope is zero at midspan (by symmetry, used implicitly in integration). It does not repeat the erroneous claim that slope vanishes at both supports, aligning with the ground truth prompt.
